title: Schwarz lemma for automorphisms of the unit disk
question-body: How do I use the Schwarz lemma to classify automorphisms of the disk? I applied the Schwarz lemma to the map but the Schwarz lemma gives no uniqueness.
answer-body: Compose with a disk automorphism; the Schwarz–Pick form settles it.

title: Automorphisms of the disk
question-body: Why is every automorphism of the unit disk a Möbius map? A hint says the Schwarz lemma applies.
answer-body: Normalise a value and a derivative, then apply uniqueness.

title: Polynomial bounds on the disk
question-body: Let p be a polynomial with sup norm 1. Is every polynomial of degree n bounded by a polynomial growth estimate on every smaller disk? My polynomial coefficient count seems off.
answer-body: Use the Bernstein inequality for the polynomial.

title: Rescaling the variable in an integral
question-body: After rescaling x to t/a the integral simplifies. Does the rescaling change the constant?
answer-body: No, the rescaling is absorbed by the Jacobian.

title: Conformal maps between planar domains
question-body: When is there a conformal map from one simply connected planar domain onto another?
answer-body: Riemann mapping theorem; in higher dimension the quasiconformal analogue fails.

title: Lemmas about holomorphic functions
question-body: Is there a lemma that bounds a holomorphic function by its value at one point?
answer-body: Yes, the maximum principle.

title: Normal families and the disk algebra
question-body: Why is a uniformly bounded sequence of holomorphic maps into the disk a normal family?
answer-body: Montel's theorem.
